name: oracle-ai-data-platform-workbench-ocidi-migrator
description: Migrate OCI Data Integration (OCI-DI) workspaces to Oracle AI Data Platform: data flows and Integration/Data Loader tasks become PySpark notebooks, pipelines and task schedules become AIDP jobs (PAUSED), and targets land as managed Delta tables. A deterministic compiler does the work; what it cannot convert safely becomes an LLM work order that Claude fills in-session, validated statically and marked for review -- never a silent guess.
